id: title:Gilbert09:add world bank open data source

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a warehouse ingestion source for World Bank Open Data, including configuration, pagination, indicator-code validation, and full-refresh-only sync behavior.
review.reason: The chunk contains both documentation and implementation. P1.F5.H2 and P1.F8.H1 provide the actual implementation of the World Bank warehouse source, including API handling, pagination, and state checkpointing. P1.F1 and P1.F2 provide configuration and metadata. P1.F6 and P1.F7 provide tests. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The chunk is split across multiple hunks and files; while implementation and tests are present, the complete release status and broader operational context are not fully supplied, though the core ingestion capability is demonstrated.
